title: BridgeVM A9 clean-host attestation v1
description: An operator statement, written before the campaign starts, that the host running both A9 journeys was clean. Like the B8 clean_host_attestation, the operator records its SHA-256 beforehand and scripts/a9-release-claim.py refuses it unless the bytes match that record, the commit is the claimed commit, host_model and macos_version equal both journey receipts (sysctl -n hw.model; sw_vers -productVersion), and attested_at is no later than the first journey start. Hashing a statement does not inspect the host: what counts as clean is the operator's definition, recorded in clean_machine_definition.
